actions.action: Track completion separately for every requested item
actions.mechanism: Aggregate receipt quantities against requested quantities; keep supplier promises separate from physical delivery evidence.
actions.implementation: Add linked request-line and receipt tables to the existing shared tracker. Show requested, received, remaining, excess, and unresolved-substitution quantities per item.
actions.check: For ten requested units, receipts of four and three must show seven received, three remaining, and incomplete status.
actions.risk: Incorrect item mappings can falsely indicate completion.

actions.action: Require a named independent substitution decision
actions.mechanism: Keep proposed replacements pending until someone other than the requester records an explicit decision and rationale.
actions.implementation: Assign one existing teammate per substitution. Record requester, original and replacement IDs, quantity conversion, decision, rationale, approver, and timestamp; preserve decision history.
actions.check: Reject requester self-approval. A delivered but unapproved replacement must remain visible without satisfying the original item.
actions.risk: An unavailable approver can delay closure; name an eligible backup.

actions.action: Validate receipts before they change completion
actions.mechanism: Duplicate detection prevents double-counting; excess deliveries create exceptions rather than silently changing requested quantities.
actions.implementation: Use supplier, receipt number, and line as a uniqueness key; flag matching contents under different numbers. Preserve excess quantities and assign disposition to an existing teammate.
actions.check: Enter a receipt twice: totals must remain unchanged. Receive twelve against ten: show two excess and unresolved disposition.
actions.risk: Similar legitimate deliveries need review, not automatic rejection.
